title: OutcomeBound validation plan v1
description: A list of named changed-risk claims, each judged by its command's exit status. Each command is an argv LIST, never a shell string: the runner uses shell=False, so "pytest -q" as one string is an executable named 'pytest -q' and will not run.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds after which each claim that sets none of its own is stopped, with everything it started, and reads UNVERIFIED. Optional: with neither this nor the claim's own timeout_seconds there is no timeout, and a claim waits for its command however long it runs.

executes_tests.description: Optional contract that the command executes at least one test, declared by the project: no_tests_exit, the command's own exit code for "no tests collected" (pytest's is 5), or ran_output, a regular expression the output holds where a test ran; exactly one. A run that executed none reads when_none (UNVERIFIED by default, or FAIL), with the command's own result kept in the detail. Without it, only the exit status counts.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds after which this claim's command, with everything it started, is stopped and reads UNVERIFIED; it takes the place of the plan's timeout_seconds. Optional: with neither set there is no timeout.
